dishes.name: Kars goose
dishes.desc: Goose is the famous meat of Kars, often cooked in a tandır oven and eaten through the cold winter months, sometimes over pilaf.

dishes.name: Kars kaşarı
dishes.desc: A large wheel cheese cut into wedges like a cake, eaten at breakfast and through the day. One of the region's best-known products alongside its honey.

dishes.name: Hangel
dishes.desc: Thin pieces of dough boiled in water and served with yogurt and a fried onion topping. A traditional Kars home dish.

dishes.name: Kars kete
dishes.desc: A flatbread-style pastry made with butter, eaten morning and evening and especially good with tea.

dishes.name: Haşıl
dishes.desc: A winter dish of specially prepared wheat cooked in water and served with butter and garlic yogurt.
